description: Joint Air Traffic Flow and Capacity Management: Small Scaling Dataset is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Alexander Gebhard Beiser, Markus Hecher (TU Wien). This dataset provides the problem instances and experimental results for the publication "Joint Air Traffic Flow and Capacity Management via Answer Set Programming, LPNMR26" by Beiser, Hecher, Musliu, and Woltran. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is MIT. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
